spec_case: electricity/docs/spec/tools-adapters-plugins.md §7 case 22 (the redaction blanket, run against the http tool's own params.url instead of a body-embedded URL)
description: The http tool's own `params['url']` (not a value nested in a header or body) carries userinfo, from a URL built entirely inside the document so the credential never flows through the templated `input` state: `meta.raw['url']` shows a userinfo-stripped form in both engines -- the recorded request the mock server actually received still carries a plain, userinfo-free host, since neither engine ever turns URL userinfo into an outgoing credential (issue #819).
